recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-43452; future live SupplyDelivery changes should be made in the OO Incubator source if that IG is the authoritative home for the resource.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 FHIR-core Supply issue asking OO to align SupplyDelivery with the workflow Event pattern by mapping SupplyDelivery.type to Event.category, SupplyDelivery.suppliedItem to Event.product, SupplyDelivery.subject to Event.subject, and SupplyDelivery.destination to Event.location.
initial_application: Commit 04bfd7e830ea8e46cf5161e75e150e880f2d3162 explicitly applied FHIR-43452 by changing SupplyDelivery.type from Event.code to Event.category and adding workflow mappings for suppliedItem/Event.product and destination/Event.location; SupplyDelivery.subject already mapped to Event.subject.
additional_context: Commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 later removed supplydelivery from active source/fhir.ini core build metadata while pointing affected OO resources toward the OO Incubator. A fetch of https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/oo-incubator/StructureDefinition-SupplyDelivery.json showed the same four workflow mappings in the current external artifact. Confluence searches found only agenda-level references to the broader OO workflow-pattern issue family, and Zulip searches found no conflicting SupplyDelivery mapping discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested mappings are present in source/supplydelivery/structuredefinition-SupplyDelivery.xml, and the resource is outside the active core build, so editing retained core source would not change the current core specification.
